title: A Lean Formalization of the Classical Seifert van Kampen Groupoid Theorem
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We explain a Lean 4 formalization of the classical Seifert van Kampen theorem for the full fundamental groupoid. For an arbitrary topological space covered by two open subsets, the inclusion-induced square of ordinary continuous-path fundamental groupoids is a pushout in the category of categories. Every point is retained as an object; no basepoint, connectedness, or separation hypothesis is required.
